name: @cas/gpu
description: The GPU substrate for the suite's WebGL2 renderers: df64 double-float deep-zoom + a complex-number GLSL stdlib (shader compile/link and colormaps to follow). Promoted from the Complex Dynamics app (Phase 5). Consumed via SOURCE by the suite's Vite bundlers (no bare-Node consumer), so no dist build is needed.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
